title: Retail Sales Performance Report: 2023–2024
executive_summary: Across 520 orders, the business generated $445,325 in total revenue over 2023–2024, with a healthy 10.1% year-over-year increase from 2023 to 2024. The East region led all regions in revenue. Within 2024, revenue grew strongly through Q3 before a modest Q4 dip. High-discount electronics orders represent a notable revenue concentration risk, and a single top customer accounts for 6.2% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: The business recorded 520 orders totalling $445,325 in revenue over the 2023–2024 period, yielding an average order value of $856.39.
The East region generated the highest revenue at $130,517, followed by North ($124,846), West ($99,428), and South ($90,534). East outpaced South by approximately $39,983.
2024 quarterly revenue showed a strong upward trend from Q1 ($36,108) through Q3 ($71,675), representing a near-doubling over two quarters, before a slight decline in Q4 ($68,949).
Revenue grew from $211,976 in 2023 to $233,349 in 2024, a year-over-year increase of 10.1% (+$21,373).
22 Electronics orders carried a discount of 20% or more, generating $50,035 in combined revenue. These high-discount orders represent 11.2% of total revenue despite being only 4.2% of all orders.

Order revenue is highly right-skewed: the mean is $856.39 but the median is only $313.28, with a standard deviation of $1,295.74. Values range from $5.27 to $7,844.02, indicating a long tail of high-value orders.
There are 222 unique customers. The single highest-revenue customer contributed $27,793, representing 6.2% of total revenue — a meaningful concentration for one customer out of 222.

limitations: The dataset covers only 520 orders; findings may not be statistically representative of broader business trends.
No product-level cost data is available, so revenue figures cannot be translated into margin or profitability.
Customer identifiers are anonymised, preventing deeper behavioural segmentation or churn analysis.
The analysis covers exactly two calendar years (2023–2024); longer historical context would strengthen trend conclusions.
High-discount Electronics orders are identified by discount_pct alone; the business rationale (promotions, clearance) is unknown and may affect interpretation.
conclusion: The business delivered solid growth in 2023–2024, with total revenue of $445,325 and a 10.1% year-over-year increase. The East and North regions are the primary revenue drivers. The 2024 intra-year trend is encouraging, though the Q4 softening warrants monitoring. The highly skewed order-value distribution and the top customer's 6.2% revenue share highlight concentration risks that management should address through customer diversification and pricing discipline on high-discount Electronics.
